title: Geometric etale stalks commute with unbounded derived tensor products
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring, and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Use the small etale site $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the constant coefficient sheaf $A_T$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf], and the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ write $K_{\bar t}\in D(A)$ for the result of applying the exact geometric-stalk functor [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] termwise to a representing complex; here $D(A)$ is the derived category of ordinary $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Derived tensor on the site is the K-flat construction [def-kun-derived-tensor]; on $D(A)$ it is the total tensor of an ordinary-module K-flat resolution [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. For all $K,L\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ there is a canonical isomorphism in $D(A)$, natural in both variables,
$$
(K\otimes_{A_T}^{\mathbf L}L)_{\bar t}\ \cong\ K_{\bar t}\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}L_{\bar t}.
$$
No boundedness, constructibility, finiteness of $A$, or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Let S be the geometric module-stalk functor. It is additive, exact and a left adjoint by the existing point/skyscraper adjunction and filtered-colimit exactness [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact]. The proved ordinary monoidal stalk construction in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.UpperLowerStar.StalkMonoidal supplies the tensor comparison. Its total-complex comparison, with the Koszul differential, descends to homotopy categories as Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomotopyCategoryδNatTrans [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Flat sheaves have flat geometric fibers by [lem-sfb-etale-flat-geometric-fibers]. Transfer this along Point.uliftSheafFiberIso to obtain S.PreservesFlat for the unlifted stalk appearing in the statement.

Apply the already proved source-library Functor.leftDerivedTensorComparison to S. Its hypotheses are exactly the exactness, monoidality, colimit preservation and preservation of flat objects established in Step 1. This construction uses functorial flat resolutions whose images are K-flat; it does not require a separate proof that every K-flat sheaf complex has K-flat stalk. The source instance isIso_leftDerivedTensorComparison makes each component c(K,L) invertible. The source lemma leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom gives its defining square with the homotopy localization tensorators and the left-derived counit. These are the existing K-flat derived tensor and its independence comparison [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-pc-module-kflat-complex, lem-kun-derived-tensor-well-defined]. The fully proved abstract transport is recorded as [lem-sfb-exact-flat-tensor-derived-counit-comparison].

Exactness identifies the total left-derived functor LS with termwise derived stalk DS by η = S.leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define e(K,L) as η(K tensor L) inverse, followed by c(K,L), followed by η(K) tensor η(L). Naturality follows by naturality of η and leftDerivedTensorComparison_naturality_tensorHom. For the normalization equation, precompose with η(K tensor L) at K = Qh(P), L = Qh(Q), cancel η with its inverse, and combine the two tensor products of maps. Use leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_app_fac on both factors, then the defining square of c from Step 2. On the other side naturality of η for μ(Qh)(P,Q) and the same counit factorization give exactly the same composite. Thus all clauses, including the specified localization square, hold without bounds or finiteness hypotheses. The public Lean helper exactFunctor_tensor_comparison carries out this transport with abstract category structures; the public theorem specializes it to S. Package the unchanged three clauses in the irreducible proposition ExactFunctorTensorComparison; its proved iff theorem exposes them, and its exists_iso accessor exposes the objectwise comparisons. This is a definitional API change only: derivedTensor is curriedTensor by definition, and the stalk, localization counits and total-complex comparison are unchanged. Consumer conversions first identify the tensor functors by reflexivity, then project to objects with congrArg and map the resulting equality isomorphism through the stalk; this avoids unfolding localized monoidal structures at concrete objects.
